snippet.title: Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch | Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch is officially OUT NOW on PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S! Prepare to command your monstrous legions, master tactical deck-building, and punish the foolish heroes who dare invade your domain.

➤ XBbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/vambrace-dungeon-monarch/9PHV1SBP7NJ1

➤ PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017443
